messages:
Priya (support): Hi team — AcmePayments opened an escalation: sudden spike in p99 latencies for text generation after yesterday's runtime rollout. Theyre on a dedicated pool in us-west-2 using rdx-large-8k, typical seq ~800. Ticket C-8421.

Priya (support): Attached are customer traces showing repeated "kernel stall" and elevated GPU compute wait times starting ~2026-03-14T17:40Z. They want an immediate mitigation and a timeline.

Andrea (infra): A quick pointer: was the FlashAttention toggle enabled in that rollout? I recall a change that made FA the default for cuda>=12.

Sam K.: Confirmed: PR 5493 flipped FA on by default for cuda>=12 and fp16 models. Deployed yesterday. Commit 9b2f4c.

Jia L.: Our canary perf before merge mostly covered seq <=512. We didn't have enough long-seq single-batch runs. If they're hitting ~800 seq, that could expose a fallback path.

Matt R.: Repro notes I used locally: set REDWOOD_FLASHATTN=1 and run single-batch loadgen at seq 800. See big p99.

```
echo "start repro" && export REDWOOD_FLASHATTN=1
loadgen --model rdx-large-8k --seq 800 --batch 1 --rps 15 --duration 180
```
With FA=1 I see p95 ~110ms, p99 ~850-950ms. With FA=0 (SDPA) p99 drops to ~220-260ms.

perf-bot: perf snapshot 2026-03-14T18:10:45Z
- FA on: p95 115ms, p99 895ms, GPU util 68%
- FA off: p95 125ms, p99 240ms, GPU util 63%

Andrea (infra): That pattern suggests most requests are fine but some hit a much slower kernel path (fallback). Could be FA fast-path vs a tiled fallback when shapes/memory alignments are unusual.

Jia L.: I pulled the kernel selector logs from a repro run. When seq > 768 the runtime chooses FA_V2; occasionally it logs "selected tiled_fallback (unaligned_stride)" and that coincides with the p99 spikes. The tiled fallback is much slower for single-shot batches.

Sam K.: We also introduced a build-time flag -DENABLE_FA_TILED_FALLBACK in the last compile. It was intended as a safety net, but it's now active in prod. Looks like it triggers for certain strides/paddings.

Matt R.: Short mitigation plan: flip REDWOOD_FLASHATTN=0 for the affected pool(s) to force SDPA kernels until we patch. Low-risk and reversible. Suggested fleetctl commands:

```
# per-pool
fleetctl set-env --pool acmepayments-usw2 REDWOOD_FLASHATTN=0
fleetctl rolling-restart --pool acmepayments-usw2 --grace 60s
```
This should reduce p99 quickly.

Andrea (infra): I'll apply to canary pool first, then to customer pool if metrics look good. Kicking off canary now.

deploy-bot: Started rolling restart for pool acmepayments-usw2-canary at 2026-03-14T18:28:10Z

Andrea (infra): Canary results: p99 collapsed from ~900ms -> ~240ms within a minute after restart. No regressions in throughput. Proceeding to target pool.

deploy-bot: Rolling restart for pool acmepayments-usw2 started at 2026-03-14T18:33:05Z

Priya (support): Customer acknowledges improvement: "p99 back to previous levels, thanks". I'll mark the mitigation applied in the ticket and inform them were working on a permanent fix.

Sam K.: Root-cause & fix plan: 1) add deterministic repro harness for the tiled fallback shape; 2) change runtime to avoid selecting tiled fallback for batch sizes <=2 or single-shot streaming; 3) remove/guard -DENABLE_FA_TILED_FALLBACK until we have more validation; 4) add long-sequence single-batch job to CI (seq 1024, batch 1, fp16).

Jia L.: Repro command I used that reproducibly shows fallback traces:

```
python tools/fa_exercise.py --model rdx-large-8k --seq 800 --batch 1 --quant fp16 --iters 250
# outputs kernel_selection.log lines: "selected FA_V2; fallback tiled_fallback; reason=unaligned_stride"
```
I attached a kernel_selection.log excerpt to the internal ticket.

Matt R.: I'll prepare a hotfix that short-circuits the tiled fallback when batch <=2 and surfaces a runtime knob: kernel_selection_policy: prefer_sdpa_on_small_batch. Hotfix PR targetting urgent branch.

perf-bot: created PERF-1209 to add seq1024 single-batch CI and nightly long-seq regression.

Andrea (infra): Ops action items: keep REDWOOD_FLASHATTN=0 for impacted pools until patch lands; add alerting rule when p99/p95 ratio > 3 for >2min to escalate sooner; document fleetctl overrides for region-wide toggles.

Sam K.: Note: disabling FA raises GPU time for some workloads. We should surface upgrade options to customers: stay on SDPA or enroll in internal RC that disables the tiled fallback but keeps FA otherwise. I'll prepare the RC binary and testing notes.

Jia L.: Also adding a tracing field "fallback_reason" into our request traces so future cases show why a fallback happened. Patch in review (PR 5518).

Matt R.: Post-incident actions (I'll own):
- remove/default the compile-time tiled-fallback flag and ship guarded runtime selection (3 days)
- CI long-seq job (1 day)
- trace instrumentation for fallback_reason (2 days)
- KB & support runbook updates with fleetctl commands and repro steps (0.5 day)

Andrea (infra): Created incident stub INC-2042 and linked the customer ticket. Will keep incident open until hotfix validated and canary merged.

perf-bot: hotfix PR 5523 created by matt.r. CI quick checks passed; long-seq job queued for nightly.

Priya (support): I'll update AcmePayments: mitigation applied, hotfix in flight, ETA ~48-72h for permanent fix, option to receive early RC. They're content with that for now.

Sam K.: Quick ops note for future: region-wide override (use sparingly):

```
fleetctl set-env --region us-west-2 REDWOOD_FLASHATTN=0
```
This impacts cost and perf profiles globally. Only SRE/Infra leads should run it.

Matt R.: Pushing hotfix PR to urgent branch and asking for expedited review. Will post canary schedule.

deploy-bot: Canary for hotfix 5523 scheduled at 2026-03-14T19:12:00Z

Priya (support): Thanks everyone. I'll keep the ticket open until the hotfix is validated and we'll add the repro + mitigation steps to the support runbook. PR follow-up requested once merged so I can offer RC to the customer. :thumbsup:

4a4 end of thread (closed for now, incident open)
